heading: BANGALORE SUPER STRIKERS SOCCER SCHOOL
body: Bangalore Super Strikers Football Club provides great opportunities for Football players, many fun-filled activities for fans and it's an excellent revenue for sponsors.

heading: GET TRAINED UNDER CERTIFIED COACHES TO BE A SUCCESSFUL PLAYER
body: Our focus is to identify, engage and train young talents and take them to the real field to play in State Level and National Level football competitions and tournaments.
